mentions.name: Bodulica
mentions.description: This service monitors official web resources for maritime traffic disruptions and power outages affecting Croatian islands and sends timely email notifications to the affected residents. It removes the need to constantly check websites or paper notices, currently covering around 15,000 inhabitants.
mentions.problem: On Croatian islands maritime traffic disruptions and power outages happen often, and constantly checking websites or paper notifications stuck on street lamp posts is impractical, while timely information is important.
mentions.audience: Around 15,000 inhabitants of Croatian islands affected by maritime traffic disruptions and power outages
